source.title: ENISA Secure by Design and Default Playbook
source.applicability: Technical implementation framework covering life-cycle management, risk management activities, and security decision workflows for software development within NIS2-relevant sectors.

passages.text: Risk management activities establish the security context by clarifying important considerations, including what needs to be protected, the threats of concern and the acceptable level of residual risk given the product's intended purpose and security impact.
